author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
You definitely want to use the Yelmogus staff. Brilliant Lights is a lot higher damage than the other options. Swansong can become better at high AL but you still want brilliant lights I think.


For followers, I'd go with trial and error. With your gear, you might not get the scaling that makes certain ones better for other people

author: nicolasallasia
body:
Normal boss horde or anguish ? Because with that setup you're going to melt them already in normal.

Aaru robe works well with pet mimic. A golem or stone warg will help with ward in case you miss some Realmshifter. Macaroni penguin is a good buffer for t.all and Fey Chimera can buff you and kill survivors like second chancers.

author: Far-Negotiation-9691
body:
Nope you need the great mimic and channel deification in second slot. Ruairc give access at your pet to cast spell and mimic love to cast buff.

Bonus point : mimic have a bestial bond on magic and orn/gold bonus

You can change heretic dress for beastfelled armor (for the berzerk bonus) it's a good alternative with more adorn slot.
